lineage: Local C1/H7 + raw96 R54/R55 conceptual continuation. New generative weights start from scratch; controller weights are not silently repurposed.
primary_hypothesis: Learned two-round inter-node messages in a causal generative graph workspace improve held next-token prediction over the same trained model with inter-node messages zeroed.
ablation: same weights, identical GRU iterations, zero inter-node messages at inference
training_precision: FP32 all parameters, FP32 gradients; Adafactor factorized moments
architecture_requirement: 300M..800M unique trainable parameters, genuine causal next-token output, no dummy/frozen parameter padding
bootstrap_learning_gate: at least 10 percent lower validation macro-NLL than seeded initialization; this is learning, not intelligence validation
architecture_hypothesis_success: at least 1 percent lower test macro-NLL versus zero-message ablation, and no lower synthetic memory answer accuracy
held_samples: up to 4 disjoint 128-token blocks per test domain; 3 generation prompts per each of 7 synthetic task families
connectome_source: synthetic; no FlyWire data found in mounted artifacts
